name: Dambulla Cave Temple (Golden Temple of Dambulla)
description: Dambulla Cave Temple, also known as the Golden Temple of Dambulla, is a breathtaking Buddhist sanctuary nestled in the Central Province. This ancient temple, carved into the side of a hill, houses over 150 Buddha statues and intricate frescoes, making it a must-see for history buffs and art lovers alike.
activities: Explore the stunning cave paintings, Admire the panoramic views, Learn about Sri Lankan Buddhism

name: Pidurangala Rajamaha Viharaya (near Sigiriya)
description: Discover the ancient Buddhist temple carved into the cliffside at Pidurangala Rajamaha Viharaya, a sacred site near Sigiriya where pilgrims marvel at the intricate carvings and the breathtaking view over the surrounding jungle.
activities: Explore the ancient temple and its surroundings, Take in the panoramic views of the jungle, Learn about the historical significance of the site

name: Enderagala Wana Senasuna (forest monastery)
description: Enderagala Wana Senasuna, a serene Buddhist forest monastery nestled among towering trees and lush vegetation, offers visitors a tranquil retreat where ancient traditions blend harmoniously with nature’s embrace.
activities: Prayer and Meditation Sessions, Nature Walks, Bird Watching

name: Wahakotte St. Anthony's Shrine
description: Discover the serene beauty of Wahakotte St. Anthony's Shrine, a charming Catholic shrine nestled amidst lush greenery and towering trees. This sacred site offers visitors a peaceful retreat with its tranquil atmosphere and historical significance.
activities: Prayer and Meditation, Reflection on Christian History, Photography
